visual_review.renderer: Poppler pdftoppm, PNG long side 1800 px
visual_review.review_scope: Representative sampling only; each listed complete page image inspected, not all 202 pages.

samples.finding: 原頁正文清楚；斜向 buildmoat.org 浮水印可辨。抽取會把浮水印字母交錯插入正文。
原頁 invalidation 清楚，抽取變成 invalidatuion；文字層存在不等於詞彙無誤。
時序圖清楚顯示 user/leader/follower 與箭頭；圖內 insert into comments、User 1234 不在抽取文字中。
原頁四欄、表頭加三種架構共四列；新 adapter 能取得 4x4 候選，但列欄意義仍須核對。
五欄圖示加文字投影片清楚；偵測到的兩個 table candidates 其實來自圖形，不能當真實表格。
S3 Outposts 投影片文字可讀，含圖示與視覺強調；頁腳為 2020 年，內容不應當成當前規格。
原頁三欄、六個案例加表頭的表格清楚；偵測器受 inline code 框影響給出 9x6 候選，不能直接採信。
原頁同時有流程 code block 與三欄表格；純文字未保留 code fence，浮水印與表格需版面核對。
hash ring 圖的節點、箭頭與黃色區間清楚；圖的區間關係不能僅由正文完整重建。
五欄儲存分層表格清楚；成本、延遲與 retrieval fee 必須保持橫向列對應，不能混成關鍵字。
原頁有跨頁表格與 Dockerfile 片段；範例換行和指令需要保留，不能用每頁前14 blocks作原始依據。
原頁的 image upload -> S3 -> Lambda -> thumbnail -> S3 流程圖清楚；箭頭和回折路徑需視覺解讀。

conclusion.source_quality: Sampled originals are readable enough for source-backed knowledge work; not a full visual validation of all PDFs.
conclusion.extraction_quality: All 18 documents require review before faithful synthesis; status does not mean damaged files.
conclusion.raw_source_action: Keep original PDFs immutable. No need to replace the collection based on current evidence.
limitations: No OCR or semantic accuracy benchmark performed.
Table detection produces false positives and structural errors; all candidates are unverified.
Rotated text is retained to avoid deleting valid diagram labels.
No full extracted text or source screenshots are saved in tracked audit artifacts.
Sampled pages do not establish an all-document error rate.

findings.issue: Page Notes truncates to first 14 blocks; headings to160 chars, ordinary blocks520. Existing Replication candidate omits71 blocks across9 pages; Container omits108 across10; CDN omits52 across4. Diagnostic compact output is not full evidence.
Bad-font gate examines first8 pages only; may miss corruption later. Blank pages set partial but summary generation continues. No OCR fallback implemented.
Existing same-filename raw copy is reused without hash comparison, while extraction and SHA are from current Downloads input. Provenance may point to stale bytes.
Rules require watermark removal, table reconstruction, code fences and visual review; implementation mostly detects/warns rather than satisfying these requirements.
Compact Summary returns first12 regex matches (including titles/incomplete lines), not balanced document synthesis. Source Map hardcodes pages1-8 instead of actual selected pages.
Table-like detection uses broad whitespace/word regex after whitespace normalization; count is not a table accuracy metric.
Hard-coded Downloads sources and run date; main overwrites rules and prior outputs; inappropriate as shared ingestion API.
Already records source paths, hash and page references; existing Tencent example is honestly blocked for font-map corruption. Useful diagnostic prototype.
